newsitem.title: INDIA: India SAIL 96/97 steel output 9.6 mln T.
newsitem.headline: India SAIL 96/97 steel output 9.6 mln T.

text.p: State-run Steel Authority of India (SAIL) said on Monday it produced 9.6 million tonnes of saleable steel in 1996/97 (April-March), a one percent increase from a year earlier.

SAIL said in a statement its steel exports increased 26 percent from a year ago. It exported 235,000 tonnes of steel between January 1997 and March 1997, about three times higher compared with the same period a year ago.
The statement said the company's production of crude steel in 1996/97 exceeded 11 million tonnes for the first time, an increase of three percent from a year earlier.
"Production of iron ore from captive mines also registered a growth of seven percent over the previous year," the statement said.
